differences.text: `open` is a boolean property/attribute and `header` a slot as well as an attribute; `close-label` names the close button. The change is announced as a cancelable `tct-open-change` before it happens (upstream `onOpenChange` after the user action).
The slide is logical and mirrored in RTL (upstream physical), driven by `translate` with the Web Animations API on exit; `side=auto` resolves from the focused trigger.
Focus returns to the trigger when the drawer closes, the page behind is inert, and the drawer is named by `label`, then the header text, then the localised "Navigation".

core.mobile-nav.notes: Guides: [mwg:navigation-drawer] modal drawer on a native dialog; [mwg:animate-to-from-top-layer] exit animation without `overlay`; [mwg:accessibility] focus return and inert background.
